panels.description: One thief studies the distant boathouse through binoculars. Keep the binoculars and eye dominant, with empty sky above.
The tanker gauge climbs while hose fittings vibrate. No faces; leave the upper area clear for lettering.
The two thieves glance toward the dark boathouse, their silhouettes framed by the tanker lamps. Leave upper deck space for the accusation.
TJ's head reaches the drone while his torso and legs close in below over the black water. Keep the approaching parts readable and reserve sky for sound lettering.
